title: Listening Drill — Signs at a park
description: Interview. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Signs at a park
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on signs in a public park. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with an audit. At the time our biggest obstacle was vandalism. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered colour preferences. It helped us improve route finding. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll test a new set of signs before winter. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
